mapper.select:
select t.T_Name as tName, u.U_Name as flowSolutionName, d.D_Name as flowCompanyName, pro.P_Name as pName,
from SYS_Flow flow left join SYS_FileTemplate t on t.T_ID=flow.T_ID left join Sys_User u on u.U_Id=flow.FlowSolution left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=flow.FlowProject left join SYS_Department d on d.D_ID=flow.FlowCompany
flow.FlowEnable = '1'
and flow.FlowName like concat('%',#{params.flowname},'%')
and u.U_Name like concat('%',#{params.flowSolutionName},'%')
and c.C_Name like concat('%',#{params.flowCompanyName},'%')
and likeCname(#{params.flowCompanyName},c.C_Id)=true
and likePname(#{params.pName},pro.P_Id)=true
and c.C_Name like concat('%',#{params.flowCompanyName},'%')
and pro.P_Name like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')
and t.T_Name like concat('%',#{params.tName},'%')
and pro.P_Name like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')
and d.D_ID in
#{depId}
and flow.Te_Id = #{params.teId}
order by flow.${params.sortFiled} ${params.sortType}
limit #{params.start},#{params.size}

select COUNT(1) from SYS_Flow flow left join SYS_FileTemplate t on t.T_ID=flow.T_ID left join Sys_User u on u.U_Id=flow.FlowSolution left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=flow.FlowProject left join Sys_Company c on c.C_ID=flow.FlowCompany
flow.FlowEnable = '1'
and flow.FlowName like concat('%',#{params.flowname},'%')
and u.U_Name like concat('%',#{params.flowSolutionName},'%')
and likeCname(#{params.flowCompanyName},c.C_Id)=true
and likePname(#{params.pName},pro.P_Id)=true
and c.C_Name like concat('%',#{params.flowCompanyName},'%')
and pro.P_Name like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')
and t.T_Name like concat('%',#{params.tName},'%')
and flow.Te_Id = #{params.teId}
mapper.sql: flow.FlowID as flowid, flow.FlowName as flowname, flow.FlowXML as flowxml, flow.FlowClient as flowclient, flow.FlowProject as flowproject, flow.FlowSolution as flowsolution, flow.FlowCompany as flowcompany, flow.FlowCreateTime as flowcreatetime, flow.FlowCreateU_ID as flowcreateuId, flow.FlowCreateU_Name as flowcreateuName, flow.FlowLastEditU_ID as flowlastedituId, flow.FlowLastEditU_Name as flowlastedituName, flow.FlowLastEditTime as flowlastedittime, flow.FlowLastEditReason as flowlasteditreason, flow.FlowVersionNum as flowversionnum, flow.FlowEnable as flowenable, flow.T_Code as tCode, flow.T_ID as tId
